flags.why: Viêm họng means throat inflammation and does not necessarily imply an infection.
flags.fix: The doctor says you have inflammation of the throat.

flags.why: The obsolete sense refers to a royal courtyard, not an indoor hall ([reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/s%C3%A2n_kh%E1%BA%A5u)).
flags.fix: royal courtyard where mandarins prostrated before the king

flags.why: Thời khắc is literary and needs a warning against treating it as an ordinary conversational word for moment ([reference](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/th%E1%BB%9Di_kh%E1%BA%AFc)).
Bột also commonly means dough or batter, which learners will encounter in everyday cooking.
flags.fix: noun | dough; batter. Example: Nhào bột cho đến khi mịn. = Knead the dough until smooth.

flags.why: Bọc meaning a bag or packet, as in một bọc đường, is mainly Southern usage.
